scope.objective: Build a crash/replay harness, deterministic recovery coverage, duplicate-worker protection, human takeover packets, and a Cytoscape v3 real run-history adapter for SCRUM-110.

required_capabilities: crash injection at action and checkpoint boundaries
human takeover packet with evidence and bounded recovery actions
real v3 run/event/checkpoint history projection for Cytoscape

validation_plan: python -m unittest tests.test_exact_state_capture tests.test_bounded_external_write tests.test_durable_checkpoint_runtime tests.test_crash_replay_harness tests.test_human_takeover_packet tests.test_v3_run_history_adapter
Run the repository FastLane/G2 validator when materialized and available
Create Draft PR only; validate checks against the exact PR head SHA
Poll CI at the configured governed interval; stop on terminal failure
forbidden_operations: expand writes outside the approved file scope

effects_after_valid_approval: create the guarded task branch from the locked base SHA
write only within the allowlisted scope
create a Draft PR and validate its exact head SHA
project updates to Jira and Slack without making them authoritative
